---
title: v3.0.3 — User-Scoped Installation and Cross-Platform Exit Handling
---

## Overview

Remove the Windows administrator and Developer Mode requirements for installer-managed Host discovery links, preserve final installation messages on both platforms, and simplify permission validation.

## Highlights

- Use Directory Junctions for Windows Work and Tooling discovery links, while retaining Directory Symbolic Links on macOS. Reuse valid links during reinstallation, safely reject incompatible or unknown links, and preserve cross-volume installation and transaction recovery.
- Scope installation locks to the actual Windows SID or macOS UID. Allow independent installations by different users while rejecting concurrent installations by the same user. Shared installation resources across users are not supported.
- Keep final success, failure, cancellation and dry-run messages visible at the outermost interactive Source, Package or Downloader entry until the user confirms exit. Preserve exit codes, finish transaction handling and cleanup before waiting, and avoid pauses in non-interactive or CI environments.
- Share a representative Codex Package permission smoke test across Windows and macOS. Validate installation and reinstallation under real non-administrator identities, with Windows Developer Mode disabled, while retaining the existing full installer and release regression suites.
- Improve Branch Validation run names and make the final confirmation depend directly on the shared Rust validation report. Align report display names across Branch, PR and Release workflows.
- Consolidate GitHub Actions and Issue maintenance instructions under the nested GitHub domain, retaining recursive discovery and the existing Frontmatter contract.
